integrity: The all-parameter proof gives exact pseudoinverse diagonals, a sharp simplex-dual Cauchy bound, an attained and unique water-filling optimizer, and separate analytic checks for both sharp uniformity thresholds and upper comparison bound. Finite exact-arithmetic and numerical tests separately reproduce selected formulas; they are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only connected positive-conductance weighted stars with independent identically distributed unit-intensity node noise and positive linear per-edge conductance prices. The objective is the largest diagonal entry of the Laplacian pseudoinverse, not trace, spectral gap, worst-pair effective resistance, or finite-time covariance. Uniform-allocation ratio extremum is a supremum, not attained at strictly positive prices. Specialized unindexed prior coverage cannot be excluded; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp price-threshold and water-filling law for minimax vertex coherence on weighted stars
